_help: Spoken lines. Each line plays at its cue in the scene (see the scene files) and the music ducks under it.
To use a real recording: drop it in assets/voice/raw/<id>.mp3|wav|m4a and run `npm run voices` (trims silence, levels loudness, measures duration).
Lines whose audio file is missing still show their caption — the video renders fine without them.
voiceId = the ElevenLabs voice used to generate the line (prompt = what was sent, with v4 audio tags).
